report:
Fresh final marker followup of meta.anchors.content.explicit_end. Preserved previous input/output, started fresh, read the complete claim and all six ordinary tests, and recaptured every previous dependency: spec test source helper lines 1–15, BookFixture lines 536–582 and browser rendering lines 146–225. Compared all fragments by path/selector and both association metadata sets. The only difference is an implementation_references comment on spec.rs validate_implementation_references. Claim, explicit-end behavior, test bodies, helper/rendering captures and metadata are unchanged; no fragments were removed. I reassessed the actual delta against the complete prior assessment below.

The sole ordinary implementation association is explicit_anchor_end with its whole spec.rs context. It examines the complete standalone HTML block line, removes its newline/CR and surrounding spaces/tabs, and requires exact equality with <!-- end anchor -->. parse_anchors invokes recognition at HTML-block start only outside tracked HTML containers; inspecting the whole block prevents individual lines inside larger comments from becoming controls. On recognition finish_anchor ends the active claim before that line and removes the active state, so the comment is excluded and following prose remains unattached until a new definition. Heading, next-definition and source-end boundaries independently close claims; no explicit marker is required. Code/inline examples and tracked HTML containers stay literal. Rendering removes only recorded parsed marker spans, not global matching text. The captured browser helper consumes shared role_replacements and skips their empty marker replacements before rendering other HTML literally.

All six tests provide visible assertions. exact_standalone_comments_end_content_and_allow_fresh_definitions covers exact syntax, padded spaces/tabs and CRLF, two fresh claims, excluded outside prose and original byte slices. malformed_looking_comments_are_content_and_do_not_end_claims retains changed internal spacing, trailing/preceding text, multiple comments, a split comment and nested-looking lines until the actual closing marker. claims_retain_all_blocks_until_the_next_definition_or_document_end checks optional markers at next definition and EOF while preserving intervening rich blocks and spans. every_atx_and_setext_heading_closes_content_until_a_new_definition covers every ATX level and both setext forms, excluding following outside prose and permitting a fresh definition without an end marker. rendering_removes_only_parsed_end_markers exercises direct and chapter rendering, retaining code/HTML-container/malformed examples and outside prose; it asserts exactly one empty replacement with the exact padded marker span. prose_rendering_hides_control_comments_but_preserves_literal_examples checks normal/outside text, absence of raw control comments, exactly three escaped literal occurrences and inline/fenced/container markup. The real BookFixture loads a normative source rather than supplying fabricated spans.

Together the evidence accounts for exact standalone syntax, allowed whitespace/line endings, immediate closure, exclusion, unattached following prose, reopening, optionality at other boundaries and literal/nonexact examples. There are no TODO or N/A entries. The unrelated association comment changes none of this evidence. No source edits, formatting, tests or workspace build were performed; executed review start/read, capture comparisons and record only. No requested edits.
